message:
feat(seed): admit constructive decisions and proof-carrying conditionals

Admit False, True, Not and Decidable through both checking engines; register checked True, False and negation decisions. Supply universe-polymorphic ite and dite and recursor-defined decide without new axioms or host proof decisions. Test local and global dictionaries, function/type/proof results, invalid witnesses and installed CLI failure isolation.

Six new regression tests; full five-package tests, scoped Clippy, workspace compilation and formatting pass locally. Remote gates repeat before non-forced publication. Related workstreams: fln-qb5, fln-kpd.
